# MCP Config Risk Check

> Paste an mcp.json, claude_desktop_config.json, or any MCP server config and get every risky pattern flagged: servers granted broad filesystem/shell access, API keys hardcoded instead of referenced from env, missing version pins, and duplicate tool names across servers. Free, private, runs entirely in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
